title: Coordination of Benefits Across Payers on an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Policy clause.** The Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)s of one encounter are combined in coverage order. When a next payer exists in the order, the primary payer's patient-responsibility amounts are forwarded to that payer as a secondary crossover and are not released to the patient; only the patient-responsibility amounts reported by the last payer in the order are released to the patient's account. A secondary claim must be received within the payer class's secondary filing limit (days from the primary remittance date) and carries the primary EOB; where the payer crosses claims over automatically, the payer crosses the claim over itself and Riverbend files no secondary claim by hand. A payer that is a payer of last resort is always ordered after every other coverage, whatever the date the coverage was reported. Payments from all payers on an encounter never exceed the encounter's billed charges; an excess is an overpayment refunded to the payer that paid last.

The secondary filing limit, the automatic-crossover setting and the payer-of-last-resort setting are read from the payer class of the claim.

**Condition, judgement, result**

| Condition | Result |
|---|---|
| A next payer exists in the coverage order | primary patient-responsibility lines are forwarded to that payer (secondary crossover), not released to the patient |
| The payer is the last in the order | its patient-responsibility lines are released to the patient's account |
| The primary payer crosses claims over automatically | Riverbend files no secondary claim by hand |
| A coverage is a payer of last resort | it is ordered after every other coverage, regardless of when it was reported |
| Total payments from all payers exceed the encounter's billed charges | the excess is an overpayment refunded to the payer that paid last |

**Worked example (hypothetical figures).** An encounter billed at 2,000.00 receives 1,500.00 from the primary payer and 600.00 from the secondary payer. Payments total 2,100.00, which is 100.00 above the billed charges; the 100.00 is an overpayment refunded to the secondary payer, the payer that paid last.
